description: Sandbag wall from x = 0 to x = wall_length: rows of pillow-shaped bags in running bond, squashed onto each other, with random yaw, offset and tint. Pivot at the start of the wall, on the ground, centred in depth. Piece: sandbags (burlap). Every bag is closed.

params.code: const m = JSON.parse(detail(0, 'materials') || '{}')[s@material]; if (!m) return; const k = haspointattrib(0, 'tint') ? point(0, 'tint', primpoints(0, @primnum)[0]) || 1 : 1; @Cd = mul(m.baseColor, k);
